stances_toward.note: Argued grade, low confidence. Fano has fought the federal army since 2023, when Abiy ordered the regional special forces folded into the federal army (many Amhara read it as disarmament); on 20 Sep 2026 its commander Zemene Kassie read the founding statement of the Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival and chairs it, an alliance whose declared aim is to remove Abiy and set up a transitional administration, and the prime minister's spokesperson Billene Seyoum accused its members of working with Eritrean money (Asmara denies). Adversary and not rival because the other side's declared aim is the end of the government and the federal answer is war, including the Afar and Amhara fronts. Why only C: no source read gives a formal terrorist designation of Fano (the OLA and the TPLF were designated in May 2021); Fano is a set of commands rather than one body, and commanders near Western Tigray may not accept an alliance with Tigray (Al Jazeera). The grade would fall to rival if talks opened with the Amhara commanders. Bond grievance: the 2023 disarmament order, the Western Tigray question and the killings of Oromo civilians in Wollega that Fano is accused of.

relations_to.summary: On 20 Sep 2026 Fano commander Zemene Kassie read, on Tigrai TV, the founding statement of the Ethiopian Peoples' Forces Alliance for Survival, which he chairs: seven groups (Fano, the TPLF, the OLA, the ONLF, the Afar Revolutionary Democratic Unity Front and the Benishangul and Gumuz movements) pledging to remove Abiy and set up a transitional administration. Fano had fought the federal army since 2023, when the regional special forces were folded into it; some Fano commanders near Western Tigray may not accept the alliance. Abiy's spokesperson accused the members of working with Eritrean money; Asmara denies it.
